headline: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels Reinjures Left Elbow
summary: 11:22pm: According to ESPN’s John Keim, Commanders head coach Dan Quinn informed the media this evening that Daniels, indeed, suffered another dislocated elbow today. headline: Bears QB Caleb Williams Carted Off After Suffering Hamstring Injury
summary: 11:30pm: According to a report tonight from Mike Florio of NBC Sports, there’s optimism Williams’ hamstring issue “is not a severe injury.” There’s belief that, assuming he suffered a hamstring strain, it could be as minor as a Grade 1, the lowest severity for hamstring injuries. headline: Mahomes and Walker shine, Butker hits winning 40-yarder as Chiefs beat Colts 33-30 in OT
summary: — The Kansas City Chiefs thought they had beaten the Indianapolis Colts on a bizarre fumble in overtime Sunday night.

headline: Kirk Cousins' 'phenomenal' play has new-look Raiders at 2-0
summary: Kirk Cousins has done more than just help the Raiders transition through a rebuilding process after two games, leading Las Vegas to its first 2-0 record since 2021.

headline: Deshaun Watson makes case in Browns win with job on line
summary: With rumblings about his starting job being on the line, quarterback Deshaun Watson responded with maybe his best game as a Cleveland Brown.

headline: Brock Purdy keeps 49ers rolling with 'MVP' game vs. Dolphins
summary: Brock Purdy authored a near-perfect game at quarterback in the 49ers' 35-13 win over the rebuilding Dolphins, ending the day with a 99.7 QBR.
